DESIGN_PRINCIPLES
FORM_FOLLOWS_FUNCTION

Every visual decision must justify its computational cost. Decoration is noise. Structure is signal.

INDUSTRIAL_MINIMALISM

Brutalist digital elements. Raw grid structures. Typography as architecture. Space as syntax.

HIGH_CONTRAST_ONLY

No mid-tones that dilute intent. Black absorbs. Red alerts. White transmits. Nothing else is permitted.

CLI_GRAMMAR

All copy follows command-line syntax: labels, colons, underscores. The user is always The Operator.

GRID_ARCHITECTURE

Layouts mirror code editors and technical documentation. Alignment is non-negotiable.
